title: Cloudflare OHTTP gateway
summary: Cloudflare announced an OHTTP (Oblivious HTTP) gateway that allows clients to make privacy-preserving HTTP requests by using Cloudflare as a relay to separate client identity from request content, preventing origin servers from seeing client IP addresses.
problem_solved: Prevents origin servers from identifying or tracking clients by their IP addresses and metadata during HTTP communications.
why_valuable: Enables widespread deployment of OHTTP privacy technology through Cloudflare's global infrastructure without requiring users to operate their own relay servers.
